items.definition:
a type of strong thin wooden board consisting of two or more layers glued and pressed together with the direction of the grain alternating
They used plywood to build the shelves.

a substance that pollutes something, especially water or the atmosphere
Carbon monoxide is a dangerous pollutant.

the act of making something clean or pure
Water purification is a vital process.

a prescribed course of medical treatment, diet, or exercise for the promotion or restoration of health
She followed a strict exercise regimen.

a person or thing that responds, especially one who is among the first to arrive at the scene of an emergency
First responders arrived quickly at the accident site.

a summary or collection of facts or items
Here's a quick roundup of the day's news.

the process of becoming an expert in a particular area
Her specialization is in ancient history.

the activity of floating down a river on a large inner tube; material in the form of a tube
We went tubing down the river last summer.

a person who supports or is a member of a trade union
The unionist argued for better worker rights.

the remains of something that has been badly damaged or destroyed
The wreckage of the plane was scattered across the field.

the air above a country
The country closed its airspace to all foreign flights.

something similar
The new digital system has no analogue in the old technology.

a person or thing that conveys
The conveyor belt moved the packages along the assembly line.

a person who takes part in a public protest or demonstration
The police tried to disperse the crowd of demonstrators.

the act of disapproving; condemnation
Her parents expressed their strong disapproval of her new boyfriend.

failure or refusal to obey rules or someone in authority
The child was punished for his disobedience.

a person or animal that lives in a particular place
The cave dwellers lived a simple life.

a system for connecting computer systems to form a local area network
You need an Ethernet cable to connect to the wired network.

a large, powerful brown bear of North America
They saw a grizzly bear in the national park.

a software component that adds a specific feature to an existing computer program
You need to install a new plugin to view this content.

a person who is studying for a higher degree after their first degree
She decided to pursue a postgraduate degree in literature.

a short, well-known saying stating a general truth or piece of advice
An old proverb says, 'Actions speak louder than words.'

vomit
He felt a sudden urge to puke.

a performance of music or poetry, typically given by one performer or a small group
She gave a piano recital at the community center.

the action or faculty of remembering something; a memory
He had no recollection of the accident.

the act of selling something again
The car's high resale value makes it a good investment.

a break or burst
The pipe suffered a rupture, causing a leak.

a cavity within a bone or other tissue
I have a terrible headache due to a sinus infection.

a person or thing that is notably good or prominent
Her performance was a real standout at the concert.

a person who habitually uses drugs, especially marijuana
The movie portrayed a group of lazy stoners.

a type of cap, often with a flat crown
She wore a wool tam on her head.

a person or thing that terminates or ends something
The terminator of the contract was clearly defined.

a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained
On a whim, she decided to book a flight to Paris.

great energy or enthusiasm
She approached her new project with great zeal.

a large tree with smooth gray bark
The forest was full of tall beech trees.

business (informal)
Let's talk biz over coffee sometime next week.

the ability to do something successfully or efficiently
The job requires a high level of technical competency.

a powerful desire for something
She had a strong craving for chocolate after a long day.

a medical procedure to remove waste products from the blood
Patients with kidney failure often require regular dialysis treatments.

the state of containing nothing
He felt a profound sense of emptiness after his friend moved away.

the destructive capacity of weapons
The army increased its firepower with new artillery.

pleasure, especially when gained from the satisfaction of a desire
He found great gratification in helping others.

an aromatic gum or other substance producing a sweet odor when burned
The temple was filled with the sweet smell of burning incense.

addict
He became a coffee junkie after working night shifts.

a person, usually a woman, trained to assist women in childbirth
The midwife helped her through the delivery.

false or inaccurate information
The spread of misinformation online is a serious problem.

a long speech by one person
The actor delivered a powerful monologue in the play.

A weight hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely.
The grandfather clock had a long, swinging pendulum.

A person or group of people standing outside a workplace or other venue as a protest or to deter others from entering.
The workers formed a picket line outside the factory.

A serious infectious disease that can cause paralysis.
The vaccine helped to eradicate polio in many parts of the world.

A reason given in justification of a course of action that is not the real reason.
He used the excuse of a headache as a pretext to leave early.

The action of giving fresh confidence or courage to someone.
She needed constant reassurance that everything would be alright.

a problem or difficulty
We hit a snag in the project when the power went out.

a medical instrument for injecting fluids
The nurse prepared the syringe for the vaccination.

a three-pronged spear
Poseidon, the Greek god of the sea, is often depicted holding a trident.

simultaneous performance or utterance of action or speech
The choir sang in perfect unison, creating a beautiful sound.

a skilled craftsperson
The market featured unique products made by local artisans.

a collection of various kinds of things
The store offered a wide assortment of candies and chocolates.

a popular trend or activity
Everyone is jumping on the healthy eating bandwagon these days.

a firm, elastic, flexible type of connective tissue
The knee joint contains a lot of cartilage.

a coffin
The casket was lowered into the grave.

a person making a claim, especially in a lawsuit or for a benefit
The claimant sought compensation for damages.

a musical composition for a solo instrument or instruments accompanied by an orchestra
The pianist performed a beautiful piano concerto.

the state or process of rotting or decaying
The decomposition of organic matter enriches the soil.
